name: nutricion-ecosystem-root
description: Ecosistema Digital de Nutrición - Monorepo MVP (Back, Front, Mobile)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACK,WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix back" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACK,WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix back" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix back && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix back && npm run build --prefix web
